camel_example: aliyun gpdb UpsertCollectionData --region cn-hangzhou --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword
description_en: Uploads vector data to a specified collection
description_zh: 上传向量数据到指定的向量集中
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb upsert-collection-data --collection document --namespace-password testpassword --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpsertCollectionData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specified region, including the instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The collection name.

You can create a collection by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html and view the list of collections by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401503.html
parameters.help_zh:
集合名。

可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html创建，并通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401503.html查看列表
parameters.name: collection

parameters.help_en:
The namespace used for tenant isolation. Default value: public.

You can create a namespace by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html and view the list of namespaces by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间，用于租户隔离，默认为public。

可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html创建，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html接口查看列表
parameters.name: namespace

fields.help_en:
The unique ID of the vector data record.

If this parameter is left empty, a unique ID is automatically generated by the database uuidgen function. If this parameter is not empty and conflicts with an existing ID in the database, the value in the database is updated with the data from the API request
fields.help_zh:
此条向量数据的唯一ID。

如果为空，则由数据库uuidgen自动生成。如果不为空，且和数据库里已有的ID冲突，则会使用API的数据更新数据库里的值
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The metadata corresponding to the vector data record. The keys must be consistent with the metadata keys defined in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html operation
fields.help_zh: 此条向量数据对应的元信息。其中key需和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html接口定义的Metadata的key一致
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en:
The index array.
The list size cannot exceed 4,000
fields.help_zh:
下标数组。
列表大小不能超过4000
fields.name: indices

fields.help_en: The list of sparse vector data
fields.name: sparse_vector

fields.help_en: The vector data list. The length must be consistent with the dimensions defined in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html operation
fields.help_zh: 向量数据列表，长度和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401497.html接口的维度一致
fields.name: vector

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple database instances. This parameter and the DBInstanceId parameter cannot be both empty. If both parameters are specified, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
parameters.name: workspace_id

Status.description_en:
The upload status. Valid values:
success: The upload succeeded.
fail: The upload failed
Status.description_zh:
上传状态，取值说明：
success：成功
fail：失败
